# VeloxTS Framework

> A TypeScript full-stack web framework providing exceptional developer experience and type safety. Built on Fastify, tRPC, Prisma, and Zod. Targets Node.js v20+ with TypeScript v5+.

VeloxTS pairs a procedure-builder API with automatic REST and tRPC adapter generation. Procedures define input/output schemas with Zod, optional guards/policies/checks for authorization, optional middleware for cross-cutting concerns, and a handler — and the framework derives the route, OpenAPI spec, and client types from that single declaration.

Quickstart: `npx create-velox-app my-app`. Default templates: `--default`, `--auth`, `--trpc`, `--rsc`, `--rsc-auth`. Default API port: 3030. Default database: SQLite via Prisma 7 driver adapter.

## Type-Safe Endpoints

- [Procedures](https://veloxts.dev/docs/endpoints/procedures/): Builder API — input, output, guard, use, query, mutation
- [Business Logic](https://veloxts.dev/docs/endpoints/business-logic/): Pipelines, transactions, domain events
- [Resource API](https://veloxts.dev/docs/endpoints/resource-api/): Field-level visibility — public / authenticated / admin tiers, auto-projection
- [Nested Relations](https://veloxts.dev/docs/endpoints/nested-relations/): hasOne / hasMany on resource schemas
- [Post-Middleware Checks](https://veloxts.dev/docs/endpoints/post-middleware-checks/): `.check()` for input + middleware-extended ctx authorization
- [Raw Responses](https://veloxts.dev/docs/endpoints/raw-responses/): `raw()` for redirects, cookies, custom headers, streams
- [Domain Modules](https://veloxts.dev/docs/endpoints/domain-modules/): Bundling services + procedures into vertical slices
- [Services](https://veloxts.dev/docs/endpoints/services/): Service definitions and dependency injection

## Router

- [REST Conventions](https://veloxts.dev/docs/router/rest-conventions/): get* / list* / create* / update* / patch* / delete* naming → HTTP methods
- [REST Overrides](https://veloxts.dev/docs/router/rest-overrides/): `.rest({ method, path })` for non-conventional routes
- [Nested Routes](https://veloxts.dev/docs/router/nested-routes/): `.parent()` and `.parents()` for nested URL paths
- [REST Adapter Config](https://veloxts.dev/docs/router/rest-adapter-config/): prefix, shortcuts, error handlers
- [tRPC Adapter](https://veloxts.dev/docs/router/trpc-adapter/): registerRpc, buildTRPCRouter
- [Middleware](https://veloxts.dev/docs/router/middleware/): `.use()` middleware contract
- [OpenAPI](https://veloxts.dev/docs/router/openapi/): Auto-generated OpenAPI 3 spec
